params.name: chain
params.description: Blockchain identifier. Supported values include aptos, algo, arb, avax, base, bnb/bsc, link, btc, bch, ada, tia, celo, atom, cro, dash, doge, eos, eth, etc, ftm, fil, flr, flow, harmony, hbar, hnt, icp, inj, kava, ksm, ltc, mina, near, op, dot, polygon, xrp, sei, sol, stx, xlm, sui, xtz, trx, ton, vet, zec.

params.name: repo_name
params.description: Name of repository that contains the update code.

params.name: tag
params.description: Node update tag. The tag contains the update version.

params.name: client
params.description: Node update client depending on the chain. For chains with no client the default value is the chain itself (e.g. geth, lighthouse, sui).

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority/severity level of the node update.

params.name: breaking_changes
params.description: Whether the update has breaking changes.

params.name: required_for_upcoming_upgrade
params.description: Whether the update is required for an upcoming network upgrade.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Size of a single page i.e. how many records to send back in the response.

items.docs: Query node update intelligence for a specific chain and network and get the latest node software updates for that chain. Supports advanced filtering, sorting, field selection and pagination via query parameters. Requires an API key.

params.name: chain
params.description: Blockchain identifier. See getNodeUpdates for the full list of supported chains.

params.name: labels
params.description: Type of feed. One of announcement, general information, time sensitive, software upgrade, problem, needs action.

params.name: clients
params.description: Array of clients this feed corresponds to depending on the chain.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Size of a single page i.e. how many records to send back in the response.

items.docs: Query the network intelligence feed for a specific chain and network and get the latest announcements (aggregated from Discord and other channels) for that chain. Supports filtering by label and client, and pagination. Requires an API key.
